comment: openclaw version -> linux/amd64 manifest digest of ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:<version>, the official image docker/Dockerfile.gateway is built FROM. build-gateway-image.yml resolves the environment's pin to a digest here and fails when the version is absent. Upgrading = add the version's digest (the platform linux/amd64 entry of the registry manifest list) and move the pin. Epic #3790 item 4, issue #3805.
